title: Counterfactual Model Testing Under Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2610.33594v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deployed machine learning (ML) models can degrade as the distribution of their input data shifts. Such shifts can result from changes in the population or from data integrity issues in the pipeline that materializes model features, two sources that operate through different mechanisms. Because labels are often absent or delayed, it is common practice to track shifts in the data instead, but a detected shift does not indicate how it affects the model. We formulate this problem as online model testing under distribution shift. Testing requires reproducing the shift on a controlled baseline with known labels. Since the same shift can come from either source, doing so requires knowing which mechanism changed. We propose a methodology that reproduces observed changes in both mechanisms to estimate current performance and the potential gain from repairing observed data integrity issues. Experiments on real-world datasets with simulated faults

translated_title: 分布偏移下的反事实模型测试
translated_abstract: 已部署的机器学习（ML）模型会随着输入数据分布的偏移而性能退化。这种偏移可能源于数据总体（人群）的变化，也可能源于生成模型特征的数据管道中的数据完整性问题，这两种来源通过不同的机制产生作用。由于标签通常缺失或延迟，常见的做法是跟踪数据中的偏移，但检测到的偏移并不能说明它对模型的影响。我们将该问题表述为分布偏移下的在线模型测试。测试需要在具有已知标签的受控基线上重现这种偏移。由于相同的偏移可能来自上述任一来源，因此这样做需要知道哪个机制发生了变化。我们提出了一种方法，能够重现两种机制中观察到的变化，以估计模型的当前性能以及修复所观察到的数据完整性问题可带来的潜在收益。在带有模拟故障的真实数据集上进行了实验验证。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种分布偏移下的在线模型测试方法，通过重现总体变化与数据完整性问题这两种机制的观测变化，来估计模型的当前性能以及修复数据完整性问题可带来的潜在性能收益。
